subject: Fix typo in bf.info.json from 'TIGHTENTING' to 'TIGHTENING' (#79)
reason: The change fixes a typo ('TIGHTENTING' -> 'TIGHTENING') in src/commands/bf.info.json, a command-metadata documentation file. These JSON files are not compiled into the module: there is no build.rs, no include_str!/include_bytes!, and no set-command-info call in the crate; commands are registered solely via the valkey_module! macro in src/lib.rs with plain flag strings, so neither COMMAND INFO nor COMMAND DOCS nor any reply is derived from the file.
